column2: A person shall be disqualified from being appointed,

or continuing, as a member of the Authority—

column2: if he is or becomes a member of Parliament or any
Provincial Council or any local authority ;
if he is not, or ceases to be a citizen of Sri Lanka ;
if he is under any law in force  in Sri Lanka or in any
other country, found or declared to be of unsound
if  he  is  serving,  or  has  served,  a  sentence  of
imprisonment imposed by any Court in Sri Lanka
if he holds or enjoys any right or benefit under any
contract made by, or on behalf of the Authority ; or
if he has any  financial or other interest as is likely
to affect prejudicially the discharge by him of his
functions as a member of the Authority.
